what.text: This page follows internal displacement in the United States Virgin Islands, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2017, the only year with a figure, IDMC recorded 2311 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for the United States Virgin Islands list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for the United States Virgin Islands.

when.text: 2017 is the only year with a figure in IDMC's data.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside the United States Virgin Islands.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
